notes.title: Trading cards have arrived!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34906522/56c2dca68bfcb057bc7137d5f77682f6929a7433.png[/img]

Ladies and gentlemen, it's finally here ー that's right, it's what you've all been waiting for! 
Today marks the arrival of [b]Rabbit Burn trading cards[/b] on Steam! What better way to splash some chaos onto your profile page? 

[h1]Try to collect as many as you can![/h1]:drgegeru::lickymeowmeow::magmadino::rabbitman::sarah_bunny:
